about_the_game:
Solar Bay Extreme is a heavy cross-platform raytracing benchmark for powerful lightweight devices.

Solar Bay Extreme takes our Solar Bay benchmark and turns up the heat. It significantly increases the existing raytracing workload with additional raytracing implementations such as ray-traced specular reflections for all surfaces and glass reflections and ray-traced soft shadows for directional light.  

Not only is there new raytracing features, but the Solar Bay scene has also been expanded. An additional assembly bay has opened next to the original area – where a rival team is competing to build their array faster.

Features:

  • Find out how your PC performs in a demanding ray traced gaming workload.

  • Upload your results to the 3DMark high scores to compare with millions of other 3DMark users.  

  • Test how performance over time changes with the Solar Bay Extreme stress test and find out if your PC performance is throttled.

 

Compare with raytracing devices running the following platforms:

  • Windows

  • macOS

  • Android

  • iOS

pc_requirements.minimum:
Windows:
  • OS:Windows 10, 64-bit or Windows 11
  • Processor:1.8 GHz dual-core
  • Memory:4GB RAM*
  • Graphics memory:4GB RAM*
  • Graphics:Vulkan 1.1 or DirectX 12 feature level 12.0
  • Storage:300 MB

*For systems with integrated GPUs, you need at least 8GB of system RAM, as the iGPU shares system RAM.

Mac:
  • OS:macOS 15 Sequoia
  • Processor:Apple Silicon M-Series SoC
  • System Memory: 8 GB
  • Graphics API: Metal
  • Storage: Included as part of 3DMark for macOS
